video_prompt: One continuous full-frame close-up shot in an elegant studio with dark walnut wood panels, a burgundy velvet curtain and a warm brass lamp; the video fills the whole frame edge to edge from the first frame to the last. The woman — a Black woman about 40 years old with deep brown skin and natural shoulder-length afro-textured hair, small gold stud earrings, wearing an emerald-green silk blouse — wearing black over-ear headphones, speaks into the black podcast microphone, alone in the shot, and stays exactly the same person the whole time: same face, same hair, same clothes, same distance from the camera. Locked-off camera on a tripod; the background stays still. The woman talks toward the right, where the other host sits off-camera, confident and knowing, explaining something, with small natural head movements.
